zh: 全局设置 → AI 助手新增「01平台接入」：粘贴 API Token 自动测试连接，保存后一键配置并启用全局对话模型（qwen3.8-27b）与生图模型（qwen-image-2.1）；还没添加自定义模型时会主动提示。
生图模型支持 OpenAI 兼容接口（/images/generations，如 qwen-image-2.1），生图模型的「测试连接」会真正生成一张测试图。
测试连接因证书策略失败时自动换一种「校验 HTTPS 证书」设置重试，成功后自动保存；切换供应商协议时不再清空已填的接口地址、Token 和模型列表。
桌面版访问 http:// 的内网模型网关不再走跳过证书校验的专用通道，避免在代理 / PAC 环境下请求卡住。
en: Global Settings → AI assistant adds 01 Platform quick connect: paste an API token to test it automatically, then save to configure and activate the global chat model (qwen3.8-27b) and image model (qwen-image-2.1); shown proactively when no custom model has been added yet.
Image models support OpenAI-compatible endpoints (/images/generations, e.g. qwen-image-2.1), and testing an image model now generates a real test image.

When a connection test fails because of the certificate policy, it retries with the other verify-HTTPS setting and saves it on success; switching provider protocols no longer clears the base URL, token or model list you entered.
On desktop, plain http:// model gateways no longer go through the certificate-skipping channel, avoiding stalled requests behind proxies or PAC.
